title: What service can actually reliably automate the 2D animation process?
author: chonky_totoro
selftext:
Please no shilling of your 1 man vibe coded project here.

I am looking for production ready reliable services that can generate 2D animations.

I know of only 1: Retrodiffusion; but it can only do walking animations or background sprites and is only pixel art. 

Everything else kinda sucks from what I've seen. Ludo does animations but is inconsistent. They seem to be using text to video models to create their animations. This is good for low quality mobile games but not much else. 

I've always wanted to make games but dont have the patience for learning and creating the art assets. Can anyone share what to use?

comments.author: beelllllll
comments.body:
This is exactly what I built autosprite for - https://www.autosprite.io/ 

I try to setup a pipeline so you can play your spritesheet in the browser and test to quickly see if it will work for you. I have custom frame selection, redos, I strive for character consistency across animations .

Every day I’m adding more and more and getting it more dialed in. I would love your feedback

replies.author: NobodyFlowers
replies.body: Feedback. You should've started with base pixel art and grew it from there. This is a tough sell as it ends up being mostly ai generated art no matter how you look at it. The thing ai can't yet do is the precise pixel art from the bottom up. You'd be solving a literal problem by figuring that out rather than...more ai generated art, which fails to come close to what a human might come up with.

replies.author: beelllllll
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! Some users have shared some pixel art generation that look pretty good. They upload the initial pixel art character, and the output animation while not perfect pixel art animation is pretty close. And you can put it down to just a few frames to get it more dialed in

replies.author: beelllllll
replies.body: But yup there is a lot of progress being made in pixel art generation, I’m reading a book on it now to try and get something that gets as close as possible on the character generator

replies.body: this actually looks good from the example on the home page. id love to see far more examples. someone else here made an entire game based of their asset generation tool. would love to see something like that!
